# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 W5 phase 1, the Eastern Mediterranean and the Danube. Generated by gen_eastmed.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 19); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, void checks, close; then the counters, the world steps, and at most
# one event in a calm, free month.
oe_emd_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_live } } set_global_variable = oe_emd_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_on } } set_variable = oe_emd_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        oe_emd_void_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { current_date >= 1467.1.1 AND = { has_variable = oe_emd_w_void has_variable = oe_emd_c_void } } }
            set_variable = oe_emd_off
            debug_log = "oe_emd: the line is closed"
        }
        else = {
            oe_emd_books = yes
            oe_emd_world = yes
            oe_emd_events = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A part becomes void when its preconditions fail before it is over (design 3.2; phase-1 end dates).
oe_emd_void_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_w_void } current_date < 1397.1.1 oe_emd_w_over = no oe_emd_w_pre = no }
        set_variable = oe_emd_w_void
        debug_log = "oe_emd: the Wallachian part is void"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_c_void } current_date < 1377.1.1 oe_emd_c_over = no oe_emd_c_pre = no }
        set_variable = oe_emd_c_void
        debug_log = "oe_emd: the Cypriot part is void"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The months each event has waited since its world step.
oe_emd_books = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_wait_2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_st_2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_2 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_emd_wait_11 NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_st_11 } } change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_11 add = 1 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps (design 3.5): only while every country involved is AI, no pop-up, no lock, each once.
# (phase 2: w0 before w1, w2 and w3 after it; phase 3: c6 and c7; phase 4: c2 and c4)
oe_emd_world = {
    # w1 Rovine (months 693-708, 30% a month, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w1 } var:oe_emd_m >= 693 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_m <= 708 oe_emd_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_w1 oe_emd_w1_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w1 } var:oe_emd_m >= 708 }
            if = { limit = { oe_emd_w1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_w1 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_w1 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_emd world step w1 missed ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws')|0])"
        }
    }
    # c1 Peter I's accession (months 263-276, 25% a month, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c1 } var:oe_emd_m >= 263 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_m <= 276 oe_emd_c1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_c1 oe_emd_c1_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c1 } var:oe_emd_m >= 276 }
            if = { limit = { oe_emd_c1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_c1 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_c1 value = 2 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_peter_king value = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_emd world step c1 missed ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws')|0])"
        }
    }
    # c3 The sack of Alexandria (months 345-354, 35% a month, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c3 } var:oe_emd_m >= 345 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_m <= 354 oe_emd_c3_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_c3 oe_emd_c3_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c3 } var:oe_emd_m >= 354 }
            if = { limit = { oe_emd_c3_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_c3 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_c3 value = 2 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_alexandria value = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_emd world step c3 missed ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws')|0])"
        }
    }
    # c5 Famagusta to Genoa (months 433-456, 20% a month, sure in the last)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c5 } var:oe_emd_m >= 433 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_m <= 456 oe_emd_c5_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_c5 oe_emd_c5_run = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c5 } var:oe_emd_m >= 456 }
            if = { limit = { oe_emd_c5_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_c5 value = 3 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_c5 value = 2 } }
            debug_log = "oe_emd world step c5 missed ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws')|0])"
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events: lapse, then at most one in a calm month while the lock is free (design 3.3).
oe_emd_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_lapse_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_11 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_emd_calm = yes oe_ml_free = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 0 oe_emd_ok_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_emd_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_emd_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_emd_pick = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_11 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_last value = 11 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.11 }
        remove_variable = oe_emd_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. A world step runs: its effect, its record (global oe_emd_ws_<s> = 1, oe_emd_at_<s> = the month), the wait of
# the event that follows it.
oe_emd_w1_run = {
    oe_emd_w1_do = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_ws_w1 value = 1 }

    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_wait_2 value = 0 }
    debug_log = "oe_emd world step w1 done in month [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_emd_m').GetValue|0] (w [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_w_flags')|0], c [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_c_flags')|0])"

# BYZ scope. w1 Rovine: the roll decides; no war, no subject relation (decision 183, note item 5).
oe_emd_w1_do = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine } remove_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine }
    random = { chance = oe_emd_rovine_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine }
        c:WAL ?= { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
        c:TUR ?= { add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 2 }
        c:TUR ?= { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
        c:WAL ?= {
            add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_emd_wal_usurper years = 2 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. c1 Peter I's accession: Hugh IV gives the throne to his son (1358.11.24; only an AI Cyprus while Hugh IV
# reigns; Hugh IV is not killed).
oe_emd_c1_do = {
    c:CYP = { set_new_ruler = character:cyp_pierre_i }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_peter_king value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. c3 Alexandria (1365.10): looted for 3 years; the Mamluks resent Cyprus, Venice its lost trade; prestige for
# Cyprus and the Knights. D4's fallback W-3 yields to oe_emd_live (D4 phase 2).
oe_emd_c3_do = {
    location:alexandria = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } }
    c:MAM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_emd_bw_alexandria target = c:CYP } }
    c:CYP = { add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus }
    c:KNI ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus } }
    c:VEN ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_emd_bw_alex_trade target = c:CYP } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_alexandria value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. c5 Famagusta to Genoa (around 1373, the peace of 1374): the owner changes, Cyprus pays Genoa six months of
# its income or what it has.
oe_emd_c5_do = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_emd_amt value = oe_emd_cyp_indemnity }
    c:CYP = {
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_emd_amt multiply = -1 }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
    }
    c:GEN = {
        add_gold = scope:oe_emd_amt
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    }
    location:famagusta = { change_location_owner = c:GEN }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_famagusta value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_emd_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
# BYZ scope. The bonds with Wallachia and Cyprus, 0-3 (later lines read them: L5, N4).
oe_emd_wal_tie_up = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_wal_tie } } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tie value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tie add = 1 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_emd_wal_tie min = 0 max = 3 }
}
oe_emd_cyp_tie_up = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_emd_cyp_tie } } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_cyp_tie value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_emd_cyp_tie add = 1 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_emd_cyp_tie min = 0 max = 3 }
}

# BYZ scope. Run a world step now: the date is ignored, the AI and the preconditions are still checked.
oe_emd_test_w1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w1 } debug_log = "oe_emd test: w1 is already recorded ([GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_emd_rd_ws')|0]); reset first" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_emd_w1_ok = yes } oe_emd_w1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: w1 cannot run now (a player involved, a precondition or a war)" }
}

# BYZ scope. Show .2: Rovine runs first if it can (date ignored); when it cannot (in 1337 the Ottomans do not border
# Wallachia), only its result is rolled, for the text, and nothing in the world changes.
oe_emd_test_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_emd_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w1 } oe_emd_w1_ok = yes } oe_emd_w1_run = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine } }
        random = { chance = oe_emd_rovine_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_emd_rovine value = 2 } }
        debug_log = "oe_emd test: Rovine could not run as a world step; its result was rolled for the text only"
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_2 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.2 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: .2 cannot be shown (Wallachia is gone)" }
}

    }
    if = { limit = { oe_emd_ev_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_emd_st_11 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_emd.11 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_emd test: .11 cannot be shown (Genoa is gone)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state and the world-step records (what the world steps changed in the world stays).
oe_emd_test_reset = {
    remove_variable = oe_emd_on
    remove_variable = oe_emd_off
    remove_variable = oe_emd_m
    remove_variable = oe_emd_w_void
    remove_variable = oe_emd_c_void
    remove_variable = oe_emd_last
    remove_variable = oe_emd_pick
    remove_variable = oe_emd_rov_side
    remove_variable = oe_emd_fam_side
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wal_tie
    remove_variable = oe_emd_cyp_tie
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_2
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wait_2
    remove_variable = oe_emd_st_11
    remove_variable = oe_emd_wait_11
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_w1
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_at_w1
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c1
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_at_c1
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c3
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_at_c3
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_ws_c5
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_at_c5
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_rovine
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_peter_king
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_alexandria
    remove_global_variable = oe_emd_famagusta
}
